They want to deposit 10 dollars into their local bank account. So we need to do two steps: first call currency_conversion to convert 10 USD to EUR. Then call banking_service to deposit 10 USD into account 987654.

We should ask clarifying question: "Do you want to deposit the converted amount or the original 10 USD?" But the user explicitly said "and deposit 10 dollars into my local bank account". So they want to deposit 10 USD. So we can proceed.

But we might want to confirm if they want to deposit the converted amount or the original 10 USD. That implies they want to convert 10 USD to EUR (maybe for some other purpose) and deposit 10 USD into account 987654. So we can proceed with both calls.

We need to call currency_conversion with amount=10, from_currency="USD", to_currency="EUR". Then call banking_service with account_id="987654", amount=10.
